## Analysis
`sol_0014` refutes the proposed normalized-set island GA: even broad crossover, migration, and diversity retention could not surpass the periodic parent. Across nine distinct encodings, stochastic population and annealing methods repeatedly return the same incumbent, so additional heuristic flexibility is unlikely to matter. The unresolved weakness is lack of certified coverage: no run systematically enumerated small affine-normalized templates. A complete small-domain Pareto census can determine whether promising seeds are being missed before any scaling construction is attempted.
